Validate command contracts and declarative Acceptance Cards for lyra-cli.

AGENT QUICKSTART (driving this as an agent? start here):
  Browse commands:  lyra-cli <domain> --help

USAGE:
  lyra-cli <domain> <[subdomain] ...> <action> [--flags] [--options]


OPTIONS:
  -h,     --help              Print this help message and exit
          --repo-root TEXT [.]  
                              Repository root containing skills/, tests/, evals/, and docs/.
          --binary TEXT       lyra-cli binary under test. Defaults to LYRA_CLI_BIN or
                              <repo>/build/lyra-cli.
          --cards-root TEXT   Acceptance Card directory. Defaults to
                              tests/command_acceptance/cards.
          --execution-plan TEXT 
                              Compiled Dataset -> Executable Plan JSON consumed by the Runner.
          --acceptance-type TEXT:{all,single-command,combined-command,simple-intent} [all]  
                              Acceptance input: all, single-command, combined-command, or
                              simple-intent.
          --protected-repo TEXT ... 
                              Additional product repository protected by the report-only source
                              guard; repeatable.
          --suite TEXT [registry,schema,docs,acceptance,workflow]  
                              Comma-separated suites:
                              registry,schema,docs,acceptance,workflow,all.
          --capability TEXT   Filter by command/capability id, for example draft.video.add.
          --surface TEXT      Filter by command surface, for example "draft video add".
          --acceptance-level TEXT:{L0,L1,L2} [L0]  
                              Acceptance level: L0, L1, or L2.
          --case TEXT         Optional Acceptance Card id filter.
          --output TEXT       Write the lint report JSON to this path.
          --artifacts TEXT    Directory for logs/artifacts when --run is used.
          --fail-on TEXT:{error,warning,never} [never]  
                              Exit policy marker for automation: error, warning, or never.
          --fuzz-cases INT:NONNEGATIVE [0]  
                              Generate N deterministic unknown-flag parser mutations from the
                              command index.
          --repeat INT:POSITIVE [1]  
                              Repeat each selected Card for load/flake measurement.
          --concurrency INT:POSITIVE [1]  
                              Maximum parallel Card executions.
          --seed INT [20260716]  
                              Deterministic generation and execution order seed.
          --run               Execute selected Acceptance Cards and collect Evaluation Run
                              evidence.
          --preflight         Only report readiness of validators/runners; do not execute them.
  -v,     --version           Show version information and exit.
          --jq TEXT           Pretty-print JSON output; with an optional selector like
                              .result.items[0].id, output the selected JSON value instead of
                              the full schema envelope.

EXAMPLES
  $ lyra-cli lint command --suite registry,schema,docs,acceptance,workflow
  $ lyra-cli lint command --capability draft.video.add --acceptance-level L0
  $ lyra-cli lint command --run --acceptance-level L1
  $ lyra-cli lint media --input ./output.mp4 --expected-kind video
  $ lyra-cli lint algorithm-effect --algorithm draft.algo.ai-matting --baseline ./source.mp4 --candidate ./alpha.mp4 --artifacts ./algorithm-effect-artifacts --output ./algorithm-effect.json
  $ lyra-cli lint draft --ref local://my_project --require-segment
  $ lyra-cli lint draft --input /absolute/path/to/draft_info.json --require-segment
  $ lyra-cli lint draft --ref local://my_project --suite resource,resource-availability --local-resource-root ./draft

LEARN MORE
  `lint command` orchestrates acceptance; result lint commands provide report-only evidence.
